item.title: 0.6.3-beta.1
item.description:
# Agent HUD 0.6.3-beta.1
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
If the required iPhone version is not yet on the App Store, cross-device features require the corresponding TestFlight version.
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### New
- Speaks nine languages: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish and Brazilian Portuguese. Pick one in Settings → General → Language, or let it follow the system. - Adds "Take me around" to the card that tells what an update adds. It starts the getting-started tour beside the HUD, and the card counts as read. - Reads Qoder, QoderWork, TRAE, WorkBuddy, CodeBuddy, ZCode and MiniMax Code accounts from each app's own sign-in. Each region is its own account: Qoder CN, TRAE CN and CodeBuddy CN show apart from the international ones. - Lets agents start DeepSeek Harness sessions, through Agent HUD's plugin in a running Harness. With none running, the Harness desktop app opens. - Lets an agent that reads the answer itself leave out the reply line (#75). With `reply_hint: false` on `send_message` or `start_session`, the message ends by asking the recipient to answer in its turn, instead of sending a message back. - Opens the windows a sign-in page asks for beside the sign-in window, and presents the system's own browser to the site, so sign-ins that open a second window or check the browser go through.
### Fixes
- Delivers agent messages to Antigravity on Windows (#77). Finding Antigravity's server took over 6 seconds on some computers, longer than a message may wait, so every message was refused. It now takes milliseconds. - Stops marking CodeBuddy, Qoder CN and QoderWork as "Requests only" on the Remote page; their conversations sync to the phone too.

# Agent HUD 0.6.12
## Compatibility
**Requires Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.2 or later** for iPhone and Apple Watch sync. Update the iPhone app before updating the Mac. Older iPhone versions cannot read this release's data.
[Get the iPhone app](https://apps.apple.com/app/id6812113619).
Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS 14 or later.
## Changes
### Fixes
- Messages from an iPhone no longer look sent when they cannot arrive. On an account with a valid purchase, a computer that had Agent HUD Remote and Remote sessions on but used no seat (more computers than seats, or "Enable this computer" turned off) takes messages only from its own network since 0.6.11. An iPhone away from that network still showed the message box and left the message in iCloud, where that computer does not read it. The computer now tells the iPhone, as soon as it knows whether it has a seat, and at once when that changes; the iPhone then hides the message box away from the computer's network and says why. This also needs Agent HUD for iPhone 1.7.13 or later. - Claude's quota no longer stays grey for hours when Claude Code is signed out or not installed and the Claude desktop app is signed in. Agent HUD read the quota through the desktop app's claude.ai cookie in that case, and claude.ai often answered with a browser check. It now reads it with the desktop app's own sign-in, every five minutes, never renews or changes that sign-in, and says in the panel that the reading comes this way and why it moves less often. With Claude Code signed in, nothing changes. - Windows: updating no longer stops on `agent-hud-engine.exe` and asks to skip files when an agent such as Codex is still open (#146). The agent kept Agent HUD's engine and MCP helper running after Agent HUD quit, so the installer could not replace them, and skipped files stayed on the old version. The installer now stops the copies in its own folder first and moves aside any that is still held. - A message to a Codex conversation that no app has open now says it is waiting (#154). The sending agent was told only that it was delivered; it now also reads that the conversation was woken in the Codex app, or that the message waits until something opens it. On Windows, as on the Mac, Agent HUD now opens such a conversation in the Codex app so the message runs; before, it waited until you opened it yourself. - Mac: a message to a Codex conversation that is open in the Codex app no longer fails with "the client does not have this session open" when the app does not answer on its connection (#147, thanks @cdk1025). It now goes into Codex's own queue for that conversation and runs once it is idle. Steering into a turn in progress still needs the app to answer.
